sql:
SELECT
  fp.family,
  MAX(fp.comp_mid_usd) AS highest_pay_midpoint,
  dc.company_name
FROM fct_posting AS fp
JOIN dim_company AS dc
  ON fp.company_key = dc.company_key
WHERE
  fp.is_open AND fp.remote_us AND fp.is_canonical_listing AND fp.comp_mid_usd IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
  fp.family,
  dc.company_name
ORDER BY
  fp.family,
  highest_pay_midpoint DESC
